notes: Corrected the flagged three-morpheme unit s034 s037 s038 → *wherewith*. בָּהּ is 3fs and its referent is the land, so it does not resume the masculine plural תַּחֲלֻאִים; the single word therefore does not carry every morpheme's sense and rule 30's condition, which rule 22's fusion rests on, is unmet.

The corrected division gives *wherewith* to the relative alone, *it* to the suffix of בָּהּ, and marks its preposition unrepresented under rule 40; the possessive suffix on תַּחֲלֻאֶיהָ, which the ASV renders by nothing, is unrepresented. Nothing in the verse is added.

The competing reading, taken by the accepted alignment, fuses all three morphemes into *wherewith* and hands the *it* to the possessive suffix; it was rejected on the gender and reference facts above.
